long_biography.plain_text:
Arison left the University of Miami to join Carnival when his father, Ted, cofounded the cruise line. Starting in sales, he moved through reservations and passenger-traffic roles before becoming president. He later took the company public and broadened Carnival through acquisitions including Holland America, Seabourn, Cunard, Costa and P&O Princess. Those deals helped turn a small family enterprise into a global cruise group.

His contribution combines inheritance with substantial operating expansion: Ted created the core business, while Micky led it for more than three decades and remains board chair. He also acquired the controlling interest in the Miami Heat, where he appointed experienced basketball executives and retained the managing-general-partner role while delegating day-to-day management. The franchise has won three NBA championships under his ownership.
